identitySignals: Organization's own website (girlsleadinggoals.org) uses the name 'Girls Leading Goals' and operates as an all-girls soccer club in San Francisco, matching the agenda's 'Girls Leading Goals, San Francisco, CA'

KTVU news article names Girls Leading Goals as a nonprofit that partnered with Oakland Roots and Soul for a clinic at Highland Community Elementary School, with OUSD's Expanded Learning Office, matching OUSD's after-school and summer program contracts
Website describes year-round programs including summer camps and elementary-age soccer, consistent with OUSD's 'Expanded Learning Elementary Sports' and 'Summer Learning Programs' agreements
research.notes: Registry details left null on purpose. The site's footer names 'Girls Leading Goals (SF SOL)'. Idealist and a search snippet link the same Geary Blvd address and EIN 46-4563540 to 'Girls Leading Girls Inc' (ProPublica lists that EIN in Novato, CA), a 501(c)(3). The agenda also names 'Girls Leading Girls' in two older titles. I could not confirm on a cited page that Girls Leading Goals and Girls Leading Girls Inc are one legal entity, so legal name, org type and EIN are not given. A reviewer could check CA Secretary of State records.

profile.summary: Girls Leading Goals, which also operates as SF SOL, is an all-girls soccer club in San Francisco. It offers soccer programs for girls from about age 5 through competitive youth teams, plus summer camps and winter futsal, all coached by women.

review.notes: The site (girlsleadinggoals.org, now branded SF SOL, formerly Girls Leading Goals) is a San Francisco all-girls soccer club, and KTVU names the nonprofit Girls Leading Goals as working with OUSD Expanded Learning in Oakland, which fits the after-school and summer sports contracts. Summary, website, phone, email and headquarters are shown on the cited site; the legal-name ambiguity with 'Girls Leading Girls' is correctly left null.
